title: 第一卷 第5章 年少骄狂，欺我老朽
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
“就是这破院子，昨天那百岁老东西就住这。”

    “啧啧，真是晦气，咱们青玄宗什么时候收过这种半截入土的货色？”

    三道年轻傲慢的声音，在院门口响起。

    为首少年青衣束发，面容倨傲，正是昨日被苏玄尘逼退的外门执事弟子——赵山。

    他身后跟着两名跟班弟子，皆是炼气二层修为，平日里依附赵山，在外门横行惯了。

    三人一大早特意绕路过来，就是为了寻苏玄尘的麻烦。

    赵山昨日当众被一个百岁老者逼退，颜面尽失。

    一夜过去，心中怨气丝毫未消，反倒愈发恼怒。

    一个风烛残年、经脉老化的老朽。

    凭什么敢顶撞他？

    凭什么能引气入体？

    简直是荒唐！

    院门被直接推开，三道身影大步踏入院中。

    赵山目光扫过院中站立的苏玄尘，满脸戏谑轻蔑。

    “老东西，命倒是挺硬，居然还没死。”

    苏玄尘抬眸，神色平静无波。

    历经百年风霜，他早已不会被几句恶语激怒。

    “同门修行，当守宗门礼法。诸位无故闯我居所，出言辱我，不合规矩。”

    “规矩？”
content_en:
"It's this shabby courtyard. The hundred-year-old guy lived here yesterday."

    "Tsk, tsk, that's really unlucky. When did our Qingxuan Sect ever collect such half-buried goods?"

    Three young and arrogant voices sounded at the entrance of the courtyard.

    The leading young man in green clothes with his hair tied up and an arrogant face is none other than Zhao Shan, the outer deacon disciple who was forced to retreat by Su Xuanchen yesterday.

    Behind him were two disciples, both of whom were at the second level of Qi Refining. They usually relied on Zhao Shan and were used to running rampant in the outer sect.

    The three of them took a special detour early in the morning just to look for trouble in Su Xuanchen.

    Zhao Shan was forced to retreat by a hundred-year-old man in front of everyone yesterday, and his face was completely lost.

    As the night passed, the resentment in my heart did not disappear at all, but instead became more and more angry.

    An old man with waning years and aging meridians.

    Why dare you contradict him?

    Why can Qi be introduced into the body?

    Absolutely ridiculous!

    The courtyard door was pushed open directly, and three figures strode into the courtyard.

    Zhao Shan glanced at Su Xuanchen standing in the courtyard, his face full of teasing contempt.

    "Old guy, your life is pretty good, you're not dead yet."

    Su Xuanchen raised his eyes, his expression calm.

    After a hundred years of hard work, he is no longer irritated by a few bad words.

    "Fellow practitioners should abide by the sect's etiquette. You broke into my residence for no reason and insulted me. It is against the rules."

    "Rules?"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 5 Young and arrogant, bullying me as an old man
